TCD.note: The page names no online authentication service.
The page lists civil-status services but states no exchange of records between the civil register and the ID system.
No count or share of people enrolled is given.
The NNI is assigned after enrolment and deduplication; no number at birth is stated.

facts.fact: ANATS, a public establishment created by Ordonnance N°001/PR/2016, states it is responsible for producing, managing and securing identity cards and other secure titles, and that it set up the SIGPTS.

TCD.note: No public register keyed on the NNI is stated.

facts.fact: The ANATS site states that the SIGPTS, after enrolment and deduplication, assigns every individual, including refugees and resident or transiting foreigners, a unique randomly generated NNI, with 29 enrolment centres listed.
